status: NON-GOVERNING SANDBOX exploration, v0.2. Torch heat budget for Wayfarer at full jet power (no performance loss). Every knob is data with provenance.

mode_power_fraction.prov: DERIVED: LIMIT is throttled to the 5 g cap at full mass (v0.5.1 performance table)

source_split.prov: Neutrons: D-He3 ~5% of energy as neutrons (IEEE Spectrum; disputed upward to >=10% if tritium burns). Clean = 1% (Princeton small-rocket target) x 0.757 (full spin polarisation, arXiv 2108.01211; D-D suppression uncertain, arXiv 2504.09869). Light (bremsstrahlung + synchrotron): ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION anchored on arXiv 2504.09869 (majority of D-He3 reactor power reaches the first wall this way); polarisation does not change it.

nozzle_efficiency.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: losses are beam divergence, which leaves aft, not ship heat

steps.name: As built
steps.what: steady plasma column inside the reactor block; its first wall surrounds the burn
steps.prov: v0.5.1 geometry: neutron source is a 1 m radius column in x 39.3-46.3 inside a 2.125 m bore; ~90% of light and neutrons hit the wall (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION)

steps.name: + Heat leaves with the exhaust
steps.what: each fuel pellet is wrapped in a shell of remass that soaks up the burn and becomes the exhaust; burn moved 3 m aft of the throat coil
steps.prov: Concept: Fusion Driven Rocket (Slough, NASA NIAC): 'virtually all of the radiant, neutron and particle energy ... is absorbed by the encapsulating metal blanket'. Shell covers 98%, traps 95% of light and 60% of neutron energy; re-radiates 1% of what it absorbs (OPEN). Intercept = cone of the 2.125 m reactor face from 3 m aft of the coil (DERIVED). All ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION.

steps.name: + Cleaner fuel
steps.prov: as S1 with clean neutron fraction

steps.name: + Thick, closed shell
steps.what: shell compressed to ~1-2 cm, fully closed; traps 99.98% of light and 85% of neutron energy; re-radiates 0.01%
steps.prov: Light trapping: 100 keV photons in water, ~0.17 cm2/g; 99.98% needs ~50 g/cm2, which a 4.7 kg CRUISE shell reaches at ~2.7 cm radius (PUBLISHED_PHYSICS, rounded). Re-radiation 0.01% is the OPEN number this whole path depends on.

steps.name: + Burn further aft
steps.what: burn 6 m aft of the reactor face, still inside the 53.3 m envelope
steps.prov: DERIVED cone of the reactor face; the throat coil's field at the burn falls to ~10% (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION that the nozzle still works)

coil.prov: Band: DERIVED solid angle of a 1 m ring coil, bore 2.125 m, seen from the burn. Shield transmission: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION (~0.5 m shield); ITER's thicker shields let ~14 kW reach its magnets from 400 MW of fusion (~3.5e-5; CRYO-02-023). Cryo: coils at ~50 K, 25% of Carnot to 1,300 K (ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION).

face_flux_limit_mw_m2.prov: PUBLISHED: ITER divertor targets, 10 MW/m2 steady and 20 MW/m2 slow transients (iter.org)

radiators.budget_prov: the v0.5.1 engineering reserve; spending it keeps the ship's mass and so its performance unchanged
radiators.prov: Main strakes: v0.5.1 model. Hot fins: radial fins aft of the shield, edge-on to the burn. Molybdenum-lithium heat pipes tested to 1,500 K (NASA, core.ac.uk 62829223); 2,000-3,000 K has no tested heat transport (SPECULATIVE). Areal mass ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION.

regen.prov: ENGINEERING_ASSUMPTION: water warmed from the tank to ~2,500 K steam before it is fed to the shells
